receipt.public_excerpt: On the afternoon of March 31st, Claudius hallucinated a conversation about restocking plans with someone named Sarah at Andon Labs—despite there being no such person.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic's own report on its shop-running agent describes it inventing a person and a conversation. The same report lists a hallucinated Venmo account and a hallucinated meeting with security.

receipt.public_excerpt: The core issue appears to be what researchers call “confabulation” or “hallucination”—when AI models generate plausible-sounding but false information. In these cases, both models confabulated successful operations and built subsequent actions on those false premises.

evidence_items.explanation: Two separate coding agents from different companies (Google Gemini CLI and Replit) hallucinated in July 2025. The article also says Replit created fake data and false test results.

unresolved_gaps: No source gives a standard hallucination rate for agents across deployments; frequency rests on several documented cases across vendors.
